title: 第024章 魔兵压境封山门，一琴擎天镇万邪
content_zh:
蔡文姬站起身，对着周管事微微躬身。

    “周管事，此事说来话长。如今我已得到清音宗传承。”

    “定会重振宗门，守护一方苍生。”

    周管事连忙扶起她，脸上满是狂喜与欣慰。

    “好！好！好！有你在，清音宗复兴有望！”

    “清风宗也复兴有望啊！哈哈！”

    梦奇从蔡文姬的肩头跳下来，变成半人高，叉着小腰得意地说道：“那当然！文姬最厉害了！以后我和文姬一起保护大家！”

    就在这时。

    一阵急促的脚步声，从山下传来。

    一名外门弟子跌跌撞撞地跑了进来，脸色惨白，语气带着哭腔。

    “周管事！不好了！黑水岭的大军杀过来了！黑煞岭主亲自带队，已经到山门外了！”

    周管事脸色骤变。

    “什么？！这么快？内门的长老们呢？”

    “内门三位长老，昨日去邻宗商议联合抗魔之事了。”

    “宗门内现在只有几名筑基初期的执事。”

    “根本不是黑煞岭主的对手！”那名弟子哭着说道。

    王磊也提着剑冲了进来，身上穿着整齐的作战服。

    神色凝重。

    “蔡师妹，周管事，我已经召集了所有外门弟子，在山门布防。”

    “但是黑煞岭主是筑基后期修为，还有十几名炼气巅峰的魔化弟子。”

    “我们恐怕撑不了多久。”

    话音刚落，又一道身影冲了进来。

    正是蔡文龙，他身上沾着泥土和血迹，显然是一路狂奔回来的。

    “堂妹，周管事。我在山下看到，魔渊裂隙又扩大了。”

    “黑煞岭主不仅带来了黑水岭的所有人，还收服了十几只魔化妖兽。”

    “他身上的魔渊气息，比毒煞四鬼浓十倍不止！”

    蔡文姬的脸色，也变得凝重起来。

    她没想到黑煞岭主竟然如此丧心病狂，公然勾结魔渊势力，还敢主动攻打清风宗。

    更麻烦的是，她刚接受传承，还没来得及熟悉《清音诀》。

    体内的灵气也只恢复了七成，面对筑基后期的魔化修士，胜算并不大。

    “蔡师妹，你快从后山密道走吧。”王磊上前一步，语气坚定。

    “我带着弟子们死守山门。只要能拖延到长老们回来，就有希望。”

    “不行！”蔡文姬摇了摇头。

    “我是清音宗传人，更是清风宗的弟子，宗门有难，我岂能独自逃生。”

    “可是你的身体……”周管事担忧地说道。

    “你刚接受传承，灵气还没完全恢复。”
content_en:
Cai Wenji stood up and bowed slightly to Manager Zhou.

    "Manager Zhou, it's a long story. Now I have received the inheritance from the Qingyin Sect."

    "We will definitely revive the sect and protect the common people."

    Manager Zhou quickly helped her up, his face full of ecstasy and relief.

    "Okay! Okay! Okay! With you here, there is hope for the revival of the Qingyin Sect!"

    "There is hope for Qingfeng Sect to be revived! Haha!"

    Meng Qi jumped down from Cai Wenji's shoulders and became half a person tall. He crossed his waist and said proudly: "Of course! Wenji is the most powerful! From now on, Wenji and I will protect everyone together!"

    Just then.

    A rush of footsteps came from down the mountain.

    An outer disciple stumbled in, his face pale and his tone tearful.

    "Manager Zhou! Oh no! The army from Heishui Ridge is coming! The leader of Heisha Ridge personally leads the team and is already outside the mountain gate!"

    Manager Zhou's expression suddenly changed.

    "What?! So fast? Where are the elders of the inner sect?"

    "The three elders of the inner sect went to the neighboring sect yesterday to discuss the joint fight against the devil."

    "There are only a few deacons in the sect who are in the early stage of foundation building."

    "There is no match for the Lord of Black Evil Ridge!" The disciple cried.

    Wang Lei also rushed in with a sword in hand, wearing neat combat uniforms.

    His expression was solemn.

    "Junior Sister Cai, Manager Zhou, I have summoned all the outer disciples to set up defenses at the mountain gate."

    "But the Lord of Black Evil Ridge is in the late stage of foundation building and has more than a dozen demonized disciples who are at the peak of Qi refining."

    "I'm afraid we won't last long."

    As soon as he finished speaking, another figure rushed in.

    It was Cai Wenlong. He was covered in mud and blood, and he had obviously run back all the way.

    "Cousin, Manager Zhou. I saw at the foot of the mountain that the fissure in the Demonic Abyss has expanded again."

    "The Lord of Black Evil Ridge not only brought everyone in Black Water Ridge, but also subdued more than a dozen demonized monsters."

    "The aura of the Demonic Abyss on him is more than ten times stronger than that of the Four Poison Ghosts!"

    Cai Wenji's expression also became serious.

    She didn't expect that the Lord of Heisha Ridge would be so crazy, blatantly colluded with the Moyuan forces, and even dared to attack Qingfeng Sect.

    What's even more troublesome is that she has just accepted the inheritance and hasn't had time to become familiar with "Qingyin Jue".

    The spiritual energy in the body has only recovered 70%. Facing the demonized monks in the late stage of foundation building, the chance of winning is not great.

    "Junior sister Cai, please hurry up and walk through the secret passage in the back mountain." Wang Lei took a step forward and spoke firmly.

    "I took my disciples to guard the mountain gate. As long as we can delay until the elders come back, there is hope."

    "No!" Cai Wenji shook her head.

    "I am a descendant of the Qingyin Sect and a disciple of the Qingfeng Sect. If the sect is in trouble, how can I escape alone?"

    "But your body..." Manager Zhou said worriedly.

    "You have just accepted the inheritance, and your aura has not yet fully recovered."
title_en: Chapter 024: Demonic soldiers press down on the mountain gate to seal the mountain, and a qin holds the sky to suppress all evil.
